facts.fact: Benbere reports that Mali laid the first stone of the Centre d'intelligence artificielle et de robotique (CIAR-Mali) near Kati in June 2023, at an estimated FCFA 3.3 billion, and that as of May 2025 its buildings were not finished.

Soynade released AfVoices-Translated, an English translation of about 159 hours of human-corrected Bambara audio from the African Next Voices dataset collected and corrected by RobotsMali, on Hugging Face.
Tidiani Togola says RobotsMali and the MALIBA-AI community have assembled hundreds of hours of Bambara recordings and built speech-recognition tools in Bambara, Bomu, Dogon and Songhai.
